title: Allow MutationObserver to observe connectedness and add unobserve()
body: Add a connectedness member to MutationObserverInit. When it is true, the observer gets a "connected" or "disconnected" record each time the target becomes connected or stops being connected, including when that happens because an ancestor or shadow host is inserted or removed. The subtree member does not apply to connectedness, as that would require a record for each node of an inserted or removed subtree. These records are queued where the connectedCallback and disconnectedCallback custom element reactions are enqueued. That puts them before the tree mutation record for the insertion or removal that caused them, also when that record is queued later, such as for replaceChildren(). The move algorithm does not queue them as it cannot change whether a node is connected. As this makes it natural to observe many individual nodes with a single MutationObserver object, also add unobserve(target), which stops observing target as requested through observe() without affecting other targets. Unlike disconnect(), it does not empty the record queue, as a record can be the result of multiple registered observers. This matches IntersectionObserver's unobserve(). Fixes #126. Fixes #533.
